The '''annexation of Asation''' by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was an event that occurred in the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]] at some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="Date 1" /> and [[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]].<ref name="Date 2" />

==The annexation==
The annexation of [[Asation]] was finalized through [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] talks conducted by an [[Unidentified Consul-General|Imperial consul-general]].<ref name="TGE" />

It was rumored that these diplomatic talks took place on [[Gree/Legends|Gree]], the forbidden [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which would make the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Consul-General|consul-general]] one of the very few non-Gree allowed to set foot on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="TGE" />

==Aftermath==
Following the annexation of Asation, the Empire established a [[consulate]] in [[Satikan]], the largest [[City/Legends|city]] of the planet, but had no [[Governor/Legends|governor]] or [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] there. A sole [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]] was put in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around Asation to give the impression of an Imperial presence. Eventually, [[Skalus]] replaced his predecessor as the new consul-general of Asation.<ref name="TGE" />

The Empire maintained their presence on Asation for at least fifteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] and had little concern with the rest of the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]] and allowed the Gree rule their worlds and did not venture away from the [[Asation system/Legends|Asation system]].<ref name="TGE" />
